home_v2.prompt:

A truly exceptional, distinctive Chinese-language website design for MajorPilot, an early-stage educational product that lets prospective postgraduate applicants try authentic tasks from AI, Data Science, and Business Analytics before making choices. This is a new art direction after the user rejected a generic template of green buttons on pastel color blocks. Strong editorial art direction, memorable brand, 8/10 creativity, agency-level typographic craft, NOT a dashboard/SaaS template. Light warm paper #F7F5EE, almost-black #171A1D, electric ultramarine #304FFE, restrained vermilion #F45B35. No green. Beautiful oversize Chinese sans and selective Chinese Song serif contrast, expressive large English discipline typography, fine technical annotation typography. Open asymmetric editorial composition, precise baseline alignment, ample breathing space. One memorable visual metaphor: three distinct observational lenses / folded translucent specimen sheets reveal different aspects of one learning-platform problem. High-quality tactile editorial 3D art with clear resin and printed paper, no generic floating glossy blobs. Practical Vue/HTML/CSS implementation: all UI text and controls remain code-native, art separable, no text baked into decorative art required. NO fabricated metrics, testimonials, university logos, admission odds, aptitude scores, launch claims. Honest phase: information collection and initial recommendation work in P1, experiential tasks are forthcoming previews. No eyebrow/kicker/pill above hero heading. No default three rounded feature-card grid, no nested cards, no dense mini-dashboard. Render as a sharp straight-on browser screenshot, no browser frame, no device mockup, legible actual Chinese copy, approximately 1440px-wide landscape desktop view.
Design the entire FIRST VIEWPORT of the marketing homepage, including simple top navigation, a complete statement/CTA/hero artwork composition, and the beginning of the next section to establish page rhythm. Top nav brand MajorPilot, links “如何体验” “探索专业”, understated “登录”. Hero left large dramatic headline in two or three lines exactly “别只看专业介绍。\n先试试，你会做什么。” The phrase “先试试” has tasteful contrasting Song typography/ultramarine emphasis, never green. Supporting copy exactly “从 AI、Data Science 与 Business Analytics 开始，在真实任务的简化情境中，感受不同专业的工作方式。” Main CTA a crafted black typographic action bar with offset slim blue edge and circular directional-arrow end, label “找到我的第一站”, secondary text link “先看看专业任务 ↗”. Small honest note below “当前可获取初始建议；专业任务即将开放。” Hero right one compelling oversized editorial sculptural composition: three overlapping translucent structured sheets/lenses with a diagonally threaded ultramarine strip, a tangible model-error specimen, abstract data points, and a simple funnel diagram as visual motifs. Code-native labels around its edges “AI / 检查模型错误”, “DS / 从数据中找证据”, “BA / 把分析变成行动”; short caption “同一个问题，三种专业视角”. These are previews, NOT functioning fake analytics. Tight optical polish, deliberate warm-paper/ink contrast, art confidently breaks the baseline once. Bottom shows an elegant horizontal transition with huge “03” on one side and text “不是测出你是谁，\n而是看见你愿意怎么做。” End at viewport fold. This must feel like a premium, intellectually curious independent product with an identifiable design signature, not a form onboarding landing page.
